description_en: Kumārī Pātī is located to the south of the main road leading from Lagankhel towards Jawalakhel. The Kumārī of Patan is traditionally offered a seat here while the chariot of Buṅgadyaḥ is being pulled away from Thati Ṭola to Jawalakhel, and she is requested to observe the procession from there. A wooden throne has is kept inside Kumārī Pātī and serves as the seat for the Goddess; it is for this reason that this Phalca is known as ‘Kumārī Pāṭī’. The locality is apparently also named after Kumārī Pāṭī.During its renovation in VS 2062, the Pāṭī was further elevated (to four storeys) above the road level in order to offer the Kumārī a more appropriate seat from which to observe the procession of Buṅgadyaḥ. Images of Aṣṭamātṛkās, Bhairava, Gaṇeśa, Śiva and other related deities can be found in the carved struts (ṭũḍāla) that support the roof.Kumārī Pāṭī was originally located across the main street towards the north-east. After its collapse in the Great Earthquake of CE 1934, it was rebuilt near its current location in front of the pond (Tapukhu). In 2005, Kumārī Pāṭī was dismantled and rebuilt once again from the ground up. The builders used new materials for its construction. Over the course of this work, the proportions and layout of the pāṭī were once again changed. The Patī was moved ca. 3 m further south to make room for the widened road; the height of the plinth and the roof were increased; a large giltgajur(finial) was added; and new staircases (flanked by two stone lions) were built. The carvings on the new pillars and struts are not very elaborate and have been covered with a thick layer of varnish. The historic timber elements have been lost.No inscription or documented evidence could so far be found regarding the time of the monument's construction and the donors behind it. Two inscriptions recording the renovation of the Pāṭī in 1935 and 2005 have been incorporated into its wall. The Pāṭī does not have aguthi.
description_ne: लगनखेलबाट जावलाखेलतिर लाग्दा मुल सडकको दक्षिणतिर यो फल्चा अवस्थित छ । बुङ्गद्यःको रथ थतिटोलबाट जावलाखेल लगिँदा पाटन कुमारीलाई यस फल्चामा विराजमान गराई रथ यात्रा अवलोकन गराउने परम्परा छ । कुमारीलाई रथ यात्रा अवलोकन गराउने उद्धेश्यले बनेको फल्चा भएकोले सन् २०६२ जीर्णोद्धारका क्रममा फल्चा बाटोको सतहबाट केही उठाई बनाएको भनाई स्थानीयको छ । सतहबाट फल्चासम्म पुग्न ४ तहको सिँढी उक्लनुपर्ने हुन्छ । फल्चाको छानो थमाइएको टुँडालहरुमा अष्टमातृका, भैरव, गणेश, शिव आदिका मूर्ति कुँदिएका छन् । फल्चाभित्र कुमारीलाई विराजित गराइने काठको सिँहासन संग्रह गरी राखिएको छ । कुमारी विराजित गराइने फल्चा भएबाट फल्चाको नाम कुमारी पाटी रहन गएको हो । यसै फल्चालाई जनाउने कुमारीपाटी शब्द हाल फल्चा आसपासको ठुलो क्षेत्रलाई बुझाउने स्थाननाम बन्न पुगेको छ ।फल्चामायसकोनिर्माणबारेजानकारीदिनेकुनैअभिलेखप्राप्तछैन।सन्१९३५रसन्२००५माफल्चाकोजीर्णोद्धारगरिएकोजानकारीदिनेदुईअभिलेखहरुभनेफल्चाकोभित्तामाटाँसिएकाछन्।कुमारीपाटीसन्१९३४कोभूकम्पपूर्वहालकोठाँउमानभईमूलसडकबाटअग्निशालातिरलाग्नेदोबाटोहुनेगर्दथ्यो।उक्तभूकम्पमाफल्चाभत्किएपछिपुनथकूकसाईनामकदाताकोसहयोगमाहालकोस्थानमास्थानान्तरणगरीनिर्माणगरिएकोहो।

historical_events.event_description: Kumārī Phalcā was renovated from the ground up using new materials. It was shifted to the south in order to make room for the widened road. This renovation saw the addition of new stairs, two lions and a giltgajur.

historical_events.event_name: Rebuilding and relocation of Kumārī Pāṭī
historical_events.event_description: Following the collapse of the old structurein the 1934 earthquake, a new Phalcā was built across the street and in front of the pond.
